(9) Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. (10) Violence against Women is any action based on gender differentiation that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, economic exploitation, social, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. (13) Sexual Violence is any act that violates a person's human dignity based on gender discrimination, which targets a person's body and sexuality that results in or may result in physical, psychological, economic, sexual, political, and/or social harm or suffering to the victim. ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION
OF WEST SERAM REGENCY
NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

Article 20
(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
(2) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out through:
 a. notification of information on employment opportunities for Women Victims of Violence;
 b. education and training for Women Victims of Violence;
 c. educational assistance for Women and Child Victims of Violence who have been withdrawn from education; and
 d. fostering and increasing the economic independence of Women Victims of Violence.
(3) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) are implemented in the form of an agreement.

Article 18
(1) Empowerment of Women Victims of acts of Violence as referred to in Article 17, is carried out by providing training to improve capability, skills and independence.
(2) Training as referred to in paragraph (1), is carried out through: a. training in the workplace;
b. training before placement; and
c. job readiness training.

Article 26
(1) The Regional Government may provide financing assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental institutions/organizations that carry out the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence.
(2) Financing assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the Region’s financial capacity and shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

Article 22
(1) Regional Apparatus is obligated to conduct supervision of the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence.
(2) Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), is conducted with the principles of:
a. professional;
b. transparent; and
c. accountable.
(3) In addition to supervision conducted by the Regional Apparatus as referred to in paragraph (1), the community may conduct supervision of the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence.
(4) Supervision conducted by the community as referred to in paragraph (3) is by conveying aspirations to the Regent or DPRD.

Article 11
(1) P2TP2A coordinates with Sub-district and Village P2TP2A, which is carried out once every 3 (three) months in performing service duties for Victims of Violence against Women and Children.
(2) The implementation of service duties as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted in accordance with standard operating procedures.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

Article 9
(1) In carrying out its duties and functions, the LPPA may coordinate with P2TP2A, the Subdistrict, the Village, and competent parties in conducting efforts to prevent and handle acts of Violence against Women and Children.
(2) Further provisions regarding the mechanism for implementing prevention duties as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with standard operating procedures.
(3) Further provisions regarding the mechanism for implementing duties as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by a Regent Regulation.

Article 7
(1) The Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out in an integrated manner through P2TP2A.
(2) The establishment of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) is determined by Regent's Decree.
(3) Further provisions regarding the position, duties, functions and working procedures of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent's Regulation.

Article 20
(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

 c. educational assistance for Women and Child Victims of Violence who have been withdrawn from education; and
 d. fostering and increasing the economic independence of Women Victims of Violence.
(3) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) are implemented in the form of an agreement.

Article 16
(1) The Regional Government is obligated to provide complaint services, in order to provide Protection for Women and Children from acts of Violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obligated to provide a recovery house or a safe house.
(3) Further provisions regarding complaint services and the services as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be regulated by a Regent’s Regulation.

Article 18
(1) Empowerment of Women Victims of acts of Violence as referred to in Article 17, is carried out by providing training to improve capability, skills and independence.
(2) Training as referred to in paragraph (1), is carried out through: a. training in the workplace;
b. training before placement; and
c. job readiness training.

(29) Integrated Service Center for Women and Child Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as LPPA, is an Integrated Service Unit established by the Regional government to provide services to Women and Child victims of violence comprehensively and with quality including Information services related to victims' rights, Complaint handling services for victims of violence against women and children, Health services for women and child victims of violence, Psychosocial services for women and child victims of violence, legal accompaniment services and repatriation and Social Reintegration services as well as safe house services through a referral mechanism. (30) Regional Action Plan is the foundation and guideline for relevant agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to implement Prevention and Protection activities for Women and Child Victims of acts of Violence. (31) Safe House is temporary housing provided to give Protection to Victims in accordance with predetermined standards. (32) Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a Child who is still in the womb. (33) Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person recognized by law as a Woman. (34) Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. (35) Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a Woman and/or Child. (36) Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother. (37) The Implementation of Protection for Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
 a. respect for human rights; b. non-discrimination; c. justice and gender equality; d. the best interests of the Child; e. respect for the opinions of Women and Children; and
 f. justice and protection for women and child Victims of Violence. g. The right of children to life, survival, and development. (38) The Implementation of Protection for Women and Children aims to:
 a. provide Services and Protection to Women and child victims of violence from gender-based violence and the best interests of children that occur in the home and community (public); b. prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children; and
 c. empower Women and Child Victims of Violence. (39) The scope of Protection for Women and Children includes:
 a. institutions; b. forms and handling mechanisms; c. prevention of acts of violence against women and children; d. accompaniment mechanisms; e. services for Victims of acts of Violence; f. Recovery of victims of acts of violence; and
 g. empowerment of Victims and their families.

ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION
OF WEST SERAM REGENCY
NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

REGARDING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

 d. fostering and increasing the economic independence of Women Victims of Violence.
(3) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) are implemented in the form of an agreement.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and
b. other legitimate sources in accordance with statutory provisions.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

ELUCIDATION

NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

(9) Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING

FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION
OF WEST SERAM REGENCY
NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

(4) The Regional People's Representative Council, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is the regional people's representative institution of West Seram Regency as an element of Regional Government administration. (5) Implementation is the form of execution of Protection for Women and Child Victims of Violence. (6) Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to Victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination. (7) Protection for Women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that Violence against Women will occur or has occurred. (8) Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so they can live, grow and develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive Protection from Violence and discrimination. (9) Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. (10) Violence against Women is any action based on gender differentiation that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, economic exploitation, social, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. (11) Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, economic exploitation, social, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. (12) Physical Violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causes death. (13) Sexual Violence is any act that violates a person's human dignity based on gender discrimination, which targets a person's body and sexuality that results in or may result in physical, psychological, economic, sexual, political, and/or social harm or suffering to the victim. (14) Economic violence is any act that neglects family members in the form of not providing proper living care or maintenance. (15) Psychological Violence is any act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person. (16) Victims are Women and Children, as well as vulnerable groups, such as persons with disabilities, who experience acts of Violence. (17) Victims of acts of Violence are individuals or groups of people who experience physical, mental or emotional suffering, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights violations, or criminal acts as well as acts of Violence committed either by state apparatus or by the state or Regional Government apparatus or by individuals. (18) Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by companions/paralegals, Professional personnel in accordance with their profession in the form of psychologists and social workers, including advocates for the strengthening and recovery of Violence Victims. (19) Accompaniment is activities and actions carried out by companions during the service process. (20) Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in providing accompaniment. (21) Repatriation is an effort to return Victims of acts of Violence to family, substitute family, or community or other social institutions that can provide social support and prevention efforts. (22) Rehabilitation is the recovery of Victims from psychosocial disorders and restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in society. (23) Recovery in a broad sense, hereinafter abbreviated as PDML, is a process of supporting women and child victims of violence to become empowered to make decisions and pursue a just, dignified, and prosperous life, through a victim-centered, rights-based, multidimensional, community-based, and sustainable, continuous, and participatory approach, carried out by the regional government involving the role of family and community. (24) Women and child protection implementation institution (hereinafter abbreviated as LPPA) is an integrated service unit established by the regional government to provide services to women and child victims of violence comprehensively, with quality, including complaint and information services, accompaniment and legal assistance, PDML services (recovery in a broad sense), consisting of counseling, psychosocial, fulfillment of economic, social and cultural rights, medical services, and safe houses through a referral mechanism; (25) Counseling is an effort to help and or assist victims in interpreting facts related to choices, plans, or adjustments that need to be made in the psychological development of victims carried out by psychologists or psychiatrists. (26) Psychosocial is a victim recovery mechanism that integrates social support in the community and fulfillment of victims' rights by the government including opening access and information for victims. (27) Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite Victims with family, community, institutions, or other social environments that can provide Protection. (28) Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, community, institutions or other social environments that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

(11) Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, economic exploitation, social, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION
OF WEST SERAM REGENCY
NUMBER 08 OF 2019
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using instruments/means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body, or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore comprehensive implementation of Protection for Women and Children is required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in West Seram Regency (SBB) so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children particularly with regard to institutional matters, forms and mechanisms of prevention, prevention of acts of Violence, accompaniment mechanisms, services for Victims of acts of Violence and empowerment of Victims of acts of Violence.

(2) The assistance mechanism as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP).
(3) Further provisions regarding the assistance mechanism as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by a Regent Regulation.

 f. justice and protection for women and child Victims of Violence. g. The right of children to life, survival, and development. (38) The Implementation of Protection for Women and Children aims to:
 a. provide Services and Protection to Women and child victims of violence from gender-based violence and the best interests of children that occur in the home and community (public); b. prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children; and
 c. empower Women and Child Victims of Violence. (39) The scope of Protection for Women and Children includes:
 a. institutions; b. forms and handling mechanisms; c. prevention of acts of violence against women and children; d. accompaniment mechanisms; e. services for Victims of acts of Violence; f. Recovery of victims of acts of violence; and
 g. empowerment of Victims and their families.

Article 20
(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
(2) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out through:
 a. notification of information on employment opportunities for Women Victims of Violence;
 b. education and training for Women Victims of Violence;
 c. educational assistance for Women and Child Victims of Violence who have been withdrawn from education; and
 d. fostering and increasing the economic independence of Women Victims of Violence.
(3) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) are implemented in the form of an agreement.
